# Project Instructions — Battle Card Game

## ⚠️ Deployment / Git Push Rule

This project is **deployed on Vercel and actively played by real users**.

**Never run `git push` (or push in any other way) unless the user explicitly
asks for it in that exact session/turn.** Committing locally is fine once a
feature is tested and approved, but pushing to GitHub goes live for players —
do not push as a routine/implicit part of finishing a task, even if a commit
was just approved. Always wait for an explicit "push it" / "nahraj to" /
equivalent instruction before pushing.
